messages.content: 你能幫我找到加州洛杉磯的素食餐廳嗎？它們至少要營業到晚上10點，然後也幫我找一下加州舊金山和華盛頓州西雅圖的素食餐廳嗎？

function.description: Locate nearby vegan restaurants based on specific criteria like operating hours. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

We need to call the function twice? Actually three times: Los Angeles, San Francisco, Seattle. The function signature: location: string, operating_hours?: number default 21. So we need to pass location strings: "Los Angeles, CA", "San Francisco, CA", "Seattle, WA". And operating_hours=22.
